o200k_base.tiktoken
==================

Source: https://openaipublic.blob.core.windows.net/encodings/o200k_base.tiktoken
Used by: extension/src/lib/o200k.js (VOM billing model "o200k")

Format: one `base64(token-bytes) rank` per line, as published by OpenAI tiktoken.
This file is data only; no OpenAI runtime code is included.

License: tiktoken is MIT-licensed. The vocabulary data is redistributed here for
local token accounting. See https://github.com/openai/tiktoken for the upstream
project and license text.
